title: decide whether cloud-search's summary follows stages in counting only pairs kept over the family cutoff
body: stages counts a pair as found only if nail kept it over the family's cutoff. summary still counts what a run reported, and that is what the cloud-search heatmaps in sets/cloud-search/analysis/summary.tbl are drawn from; the real sweep at -a 5 and -a 1 was parsed under that definition. An earlier stages made the same mistake and read 0.9646 against 0.9103 for static-ms20000 on MGnify.
